name: What types of molding are installed on kitchen cabinets?

mainEntity.name: What types of molding are installed on kitchen cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: The most common kitchen moldings include crown molding, light rail molding, toe kicks, and baseboards. Crown molding sits atop upper cabinets or joins them to the ceiling to create a finished appearance. Light rail molding attaches to the bottom edge of upper cabinets to conceal under-cabinet lighting fixtures and wiring. Baseboards and toe kicks protect lower cabinet bases from foot traffic, scuffs, and moisture. Choosing the right profile depends on your cabinet door style: flat or shaker doors suit simple square stock profiles, while raised-panel cabinets typically pair best with traditional contoured profiles.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common kitchen moldings include crown molding along cabinet tops, light rail molding underneath to hide lighting, and baseboards or toe kicks along the floor.
